Module com.example.demo
Package com.example.miniproyecto4.model.interfaces

Interface Opponent

All Known Implementing Classes:
HumanPlayer, MachinePlayer
public interface Opponent
Defines the common behavior required by any participant in a Battleship match. Both human and machine players implement this interface so that the game controller can interact with either type of opponent through the same set of operations.
